note: Bridger-Teton NF campground just outside the Teton Wilderness and the Rockefeller Parkway, 0.5 mi up dirt FS Road 30504 from US-89/191/287 just south of the Snake River bridge at Flagg Ranch. The road crosses a creek: the FS warns that water levels can change quickly in warm weather. Sheffield Trailhead (Huckleberry Lookout) nearby. --Claude
